# `report_block` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/report_block.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

A report placed in the page order (doc 03 §6, doc 09 §2.2, rank 45). Page-oriented blocks live in
`report-blocks.jsonl`, embedded blocks in the file of `embedded.page`. Its pages are derived.

Not in v0: `filter` (typed predicate or rhai expression, FR-EXT-011), `Kind.params`, the header and
footer rows of `group`, and `EmbedSpec.overflow`; their encodings are open (doc 09).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `report_block` |
| File | `report-blocks.jsonl or pages/<page>.jsonl` |
| Rank | 45 |
| Status | implemented |
| Record version | 1 |
| Schema | [`report_block.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/schemas/0.1/report_block.schema.json) |

## Types

### ContinuationPolicy

Continuation numbering of report pages.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"sub_page"` | 907, 907.1, 907.2 … (the default). |
| `"next_folio"` | 907, 908, 909 … |

### EmbedSpec

Placement of an embedded report block.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | [`Uuid`](#uuid) | yes |  | The page. |
| `rect` | [`Rect`](#rect) | yes |  | The area on the page. |

### EmptyPolicy

What a block without rows prints.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: No pages (the default).

   Shape: `"omit_pages"`

2. **Form 2**: One page with this text.

   Shape: object { `one_page`: [`MlText`](#mltext) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `one_page` | [`MlText`](#mltext) | yes |  | Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both. |

### GroupSpec

Grouping of report rows.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `break` | [`GroupBreak`](#groupbreak) | no |  | What happens at a group change; default nothing. |
| `key` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | The group key column. |

### GroupBreak

What happens at a group change.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"none"` | Rows continue. |
| `"new_page"` | A new page. |
| `"new_folio"` | A new folio. |

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### ManualSelection

Explicit include and exclude lists of entity IDs (sets, sorted).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `exclude` | array of [`Uuid`](#uuid) (items unique) | no |  | Entities always excluded. |
| `include` | array of [`Uuid`](#uuid) (items unique) | no |  | Entities always included. |

### MlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### Rect

A rectangle [[x0, y0], [x1, y1]] in nanometres, minimum corner first (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: array of ([`Pt2`](#pt2), [`Pt2`](#pt2)) (at least 2 item(s))

### Pt2

A point [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

### ReportSource

The row source of a report block: `{"kind": "<report kind>"}` or `{"sql_query": {"api", "file"}}`.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A built-in report kind (doc 09 §2.4).

   Shape: object { `kind`: [`ReportKind`](#reportkind) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `kind` | [`ReportKind`](#reportkind) | yes |  | The built-in report kinds of the MVP (doc 09 §2.4); later kinds arrive as additive variants. |

2. **Form 2**: A user SQL report in `reports/<file>.sql` (untrusted until the project is trusted).

   Shape: object { `sql_query`: [`SqlQuery`](#sqlquery) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `sql_query` | [`SqlQuery`](#sqlquery) | yes |  | A user SQL report. |
